name: Highland Village
summary: Highland Village is Houston's most exclusive outdoor shopping venue, featuring upscale boutiques, premier national retailers like Restoration Hardware and Apple, and fine dining options along a beautifully landscaped palm-lined boulevard. This sophisticated lifestyle center offers complimentary valet service and an on-site trolley, creating a distinctive main street shopping experience in the heart of Houston's most fashionable neighborhoods.
demographics: Highland Village attracts an affluent, upscale demographic from Houston's most fashionable neighborhoods including River Oaks, Tanglewood, and Memorial. The primary visitor base consists of high-income households with annual incomes exceeding $150,000, skewing toward educated professionals aged 30-55 and affluent retirees. The trade area is characterized by luxury homeowners who value quality over price, seeking premium brands and personalized shopping experiences. Shoppers typically visit for leisurely browsing sessions combined with dining, reflecting a lifestyle-oriented approach rather than utilitarian shopping trips.
description: Highland Village stands as Houston's premier upscale outdoor shopping destination, situated on a palm tree-lined boulevard at 4055 Westheimer Road in the heart of the city's most prestigious neighborhoods. This sophisticated lifestyle center embodies the main street shopping experience with its beautifully landscaped storefronts and collection of elevated boutiques alongside nationally recognized retailers. The center offers an impressive roster of premium tenants including Restoration Hardware, Apple, Lululemon, Anthropologie, Crate&Barrel, and Sephora, complemented by upscale dining options like Ra Sushi and Gauchos Do Sul. Highland Village distinguishes itself through exceptional amenities including complimentary valet services, an on-site trolley service, and generous front-door parking that provides the ultimate in convenience. With its modern yet timeless aesthetic and carefully curated mix of fashion, specialty retail, and dining establishments, Highland Village has established itself as the destination for discerning shoppers seeking a leisurely day of shopping followed by cocktails and dinner with friends.
